ai_disclosure: Collaborated with ChatGPT to review the changes introduced in #30882, identify the unsound derivative-based inference, develop a more conservative implementation, and add regression tests.
author: smichr

entries.text: Restricted nonpolynomial sign inference to affine transformations of `exp`, `log`, and `sqrt` with univariate affine arguments and appropriate domain restrictions, while preserving existing polynomial inference. This prevents incorrect sign assumptions for discontinuous expressions over integer domains.
